title: 第25章 孙幼薇芳心震颤第26章 楚枫 我是丹帝你信吗
content_zh:

read2（）;“《御兽灵诀》近万年来无人能够参悟，你究竟是如何控制那只天煞鬼虎的？”
天煞鬼虎性情凶戾，可楚枫却能让天煞鬼虎为了保护赵有容，不惜直面五阶的幻灵白虎，这显然是完全掌控了天煞鬼虎的表现。
楚枫看着温玉颜好奇的模样，嘴角的笑容更深了。
“这是秘密。”
他自然不会告诉温玉颜，自己的炼天图可以炼化一切功法，《御兽灵诀》在炼天图面前，根本毫无秘密可言。
温玉颜见他不肯说，也没有追问。
她知道每个人都有自己的秘密，强行追问只会引起反感。
她轻轻哼了一声，试图掩饰自己的好奇。
楚枫开始转移话题：“我们还是快点回去吧，你的妖兽这会怕是都怀上了。”
一想到那只可恶的天煞鬼虎，温玉颜就恨得牙痒痒。
若不是那只孽畜，她也不会落到如此境地，幻灵白虎也不会化为魅灵白虎，永远失去进阶六阶的机会。
楚枫强忍着笑意，看着她咬牙切齿的模样，觉得有些可爱。
“你有没有想过，天煞鬼虎和幻灵白虎生出来的异种后代，天赋或许会远超普通妖兽，能力会更加强大。
而且，幼崽若是从小喂养驯化，会比成年妖兽更容易驯服，忠诚度也会更高。”
此话一出，温玉颜的美眸微微动了一下。
之前她一直极力阻止幻灵白虎交配，就是担心它化为魅灵白虎，无法进阶六阶。
可如今木已成舟，幻灵白虎已经彻底变成了魅灵白虎，再纠结于过去也没有意义了。
既然如此，不如顺水推舟，让它诞下幼崽。
五阶魅灵白虎与四阶天煞鬼虎的后代，绝对是万中无一的异种妖兽，潜力无穷。

若是能将其驯服，日后必然会成为一大助力，也算是弥补了幻灵白虎无法进阶的损失。
“若是它真的诞下了幼崽，幼崽要归我。”
魅灵白虎一胎只会诞下一只幼崽，根本无法分割，所以必须提前声明。
楚枫看着她较真的模样，语气随意地说道。
“当然，那幼崽在魅灵白虎的肚子里，我怎么可能跟你抢。”
温玉颜闻言，心中微微松了口气。
她点了点头，不再说话，开始整理自己凌乱的衣物。
黑色的长裙早已沾满了泥土与草林，布满了褶皱，还有几道撕裂的口子，根本无法再穿。
她从空间纳戒之中取出一套新的裙子，而后有些幽怨的瞪了楚枫一眼。
淡青色的长裙将她玲珑有致的身材勾勒得淋漓尽致，比之前的黑色长裙多了一丝温婉，少了几分妖媚。
……
楚家。
赵有容一夜未睡，自从昨晚楚枫追着温玉颜离开后，她便一直心神不宁，坐立难安。
她守在大门口，望着城外的方向，眼中满是焦急，生怕楚枫会出什么意外。
直到看到楚枫和温玉颜一同出现在天际，朝着楚家飞来，赵有容悬着的心才终于落了下来。
她快步迎了上去，在楚枫落地的瞬间，直接扑入了他的怀里，紧紧地抱住了他的腰身。
“夫君，你终于回来了，你没事吧？有没有受伤？”
赵有容的声音带着一丝哽咽，脸颊紧紧贴在楚枫的胸膛上，感受着他的心跳，心中的不安才彻底消散。

read2(); "No one has been able to comprehend the "Spiritual Art of Controlling Beasts" for nearly ten thousand years. How on earth did you control that evil ghost tiger?"
The Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger has a ferocious temperament, but Chu Feng was able to make the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger not hesitate to face the fifth-level phantom white tiger in order to protect Zhao Yourong. This was obviously a complete control over the performance of the Heavenly Evil Ghost Tiger.
Chu Feng looked at Wen Yuyan's curious look, and the smile on his lips deepened.
"It's a secret."
Naturally, he would not tell Wen Yuyan that his Heaven Refining Diagram could refine all techniques. The "Spiritual Art of Controlling Beasts" had no secrets at all in front of the Heaven Refining Diagram.
Seeing that he refused to say anything, Wen Yuyan did not ask further questions.
She knows that everyone has their own secrets, and asking them forcefully will only cause resentment.
She hummed slightly, trying to hide her curiosity.
Chu Feng began to change the topic: "Let's go back quickly. I'm afraid all your monsters will be pregnant now."
When Wen Yuyan thought of that abominable evil spirit tiger, her teeth itched with hatred.
If it weren't for that evil beast, she wouldn't be in such a situation, and the phantom white tiger wouldn't turn into a phantom white tiger, forever losing the opportunity to advance to the sixth level.
Chu Feng suppressed a smile and looked at her gnashing her teeth, feeling a little cute.
"Have you ever thought that the heterogeneous offspring born from the evil ghost tiger and the phantom white tiger may have talents that far exceed those of ordinary monsters and their abilities will be even more powerful.
Moreover, if the cubs are raised and domesticated from an early age, they will be easier to tame than the adult monsters and will be more loyal. "
As soon as these words came out, Wen Yuyan's beautiful eyes moved slightly.
She had been trying her best to prevent the phantom white tiger from mating before, because she was worried that it would turn into a phantom white tiger and be unable to advance to the sixth level.
But now the deal is done, the Phantom White Tiger has completely turned into the Phantom White Tiger, and there is no point in dwelling on the past.
In this case, it is better to let the situation go and let it give birth to cubs.
The descendant of the fifth-level enchanted white tiger and the fourth-level evil ghost tiger is definitely a one-of-a-kind alien beast with endless potential.
If it can be tamed, it will definitely become a big help in the future, which can be regarded as making up for the loss of the Phantom White Tiger being unable to advance.
"If it really gives birth to a cub, the cub will be mine."
The Charming White Tiger will only give birth to one cub at a time, which cannot be separated at all, so it must be stated in advance.
Chu Feng looked at her serious appearance and said in a casual tone.
"Of course, the cub is in the belly of the white tiger. How could I snatch it from you?"
When Wen Yuyan heard this, she felt slightly relieved.
She nodded, stopped talking, and began to sort out her messy clothes.
The long black skirt was already stained with mud and grass, full of wrinkles, and had several torn holes, making it impossible to wear again.
She took out a new set of skirts from the space ring, and then glared at Chu Feng with some resentment.
The light blue dress perfectly outlined her exquisite figure. It was more gentle and less seductive than the previous black dress.
…
Chu family.
Zhao Yourong stayed up all night. Ever since Chu Feng chased Wen Yuyan away last night, she had been restless and restless.
She stood guard at the gate, looking in the direction outside the city, her eyes full of anxiety, fearing that something unexpected would happen to Chu Feng.
It wasn't until he saw Chu Feng and Wen Yuyan appearing in the sky together, flying towards the Chu family, that Zhao Yourong's anxious heart finally settled.
She rushed forward to meet Chu Feng, and the moment Chu Feng landed, she threw herself directly into his arms and hugged his waist tightly.
"Husband, you are finally back. Are you okay? Are you injured?"
Zhao Yourong's voice was choked with sobs, and he pressed his cheek tightly against Chu Feng's chest. Feeling his heartbeat, the uneasiness in his heart completely dissipated.
